records.title: Initial Antenatal Intake & Viability Ultrasound Note
records.author: Dr. Eleanor Vance, MD
records.summaryText: 8-week transvaginal ultrasound confirmed intrauterine pregnancy with active fetal cardiac activity (162 bpm). EDD calculated as Nov 20, 2026 based on CRL 18.4mm.
records.fullContent:
CLINICAL NOTE - INITIAL OB VISIT
Date: April 10, 2026
Patient: Sarah Jenkins (31yo G2 P1001)

CHIEF COMPLAINT: Confirmation of pregnancy, positive home pregnancy test.
PAST OBSTETRIC HISTORY: G1 ended in full term spontaneous vaginal delivery in 2021 (3.4kg, no maternal complications).

ULTRASOUND FINDINGS:
Transvaginal scan performed. Single live intrauterine pregnancy demonstrated. Fetal heart rate measured at 162 bpm. Crown-rump length (CRL) measures 18.4 mm, corresponding to 8 weeks 2 days gestation. No subchorionic hematoma identified.

ASSESSMENT & PLAN:
1. Intrauterine pregnancy at 8w2d, concordant with last menstrual period.
2. Routine prenatal vitamins prescribed.
3. Lab panel ordered: CBC, Type & Screen, Rubella, Hepatitis B, HIV, Syphilis, Pap smear.
4. Scheduled for 12-week Nuchal Translucency screening.

Date: July 2, 2026
Gestational Age: 20 weeks 1 day

FINDINGS:
Single fetus in variable presentation. Biometry (BPD, HC, AC, FL) yields an average sonographic age of 20w1d. Estimated Fetal Weight: 345 grams (48th percentile).

Cervical length: 38 mm (Closed).

Date: September 2, 2026

REASON FOR VISIT: Gestational Diabetes Mellitus Management.

INTERVENTION:
- Reviewed carbohydrate counts and meal timing (3 main meals + 3 snacks).
- Patient demonstrated proper glucometer calibration and finger-stick technique.

- Instructed to log readings 4x daily and submit weekly.
